summary: Stop signs lettered in road-sign type on clean red sheeting, without the dark smudge.
rationale: Appearance change of one small piece: a matched studio close-up shows the letter shapes, the white and the smudge gone, in the sun and in the sign's own shade; matched crops from the game's camera at 20 m and at the default 55 m zoom show what a player actually sees. Compatibility renders were reviewed but not committed: they match Forward+.
